title: Missing authorization on a Swift server route or privileged operation
preconditions: a Vapor/NIO request reaches a sensitive operation
route registration or middleware determines whether a principal is required
dangerous_transitions: request reaches a sensitive operation without an effective authentication/authorization policy
sink_semantics: database, filesystem, or administrative operations reachable from a request
counterevidence: Safe high-level Swift collection access retains runtime bounds checks.
The foreign pointer contract and owner lifetime are validated at the boundary.
verification_recipe: Enumerate route registrations, groups, middleware order, and aliases.
Test anonymous and least-privileged requests against the sensitive operation.
